findings.humor_and_voices: Neet turns a birthday outing into his own spectacular mission; the underwater-dog-park claim, pre-empting Buddy’s list of past scenes, mutual penguin rejection and fish connections deliver specific character comedy. Buddy has quiet fascination, protects Heather’s turn and then falls into his own otter chase; Heather actively catches that contradiction. Voices remain distinct and affectionate.
findings.cause_effect_and_pacing: Tank reach produces splash, rescue and Buddy’s decision to guard Heather’s turn. Otter fish provocation follows Neet claiming kinship with otters; the slow sliding fish pause precedes retaliation and removal. Quiet jellyfish interval and warm dinner balance the loud physical incidents.
findings.ending_continuity: The actual ending remains dinner at a seafood restaurant followed by Heather’s glass and the dogs’ water-bowl toast. Buddy explicitly says Next year before proposing his surprise party. Neet’s With a pool is a callback to this aquarium disaster, and no party is actually held or imported from S028.
image_placement: Jellyfish image follows Heather’s quiet minute beside Buddy and precedes Neet’s It’s got you doing it now; Buddy’s raised chin and Neet’s side-eye support that state.
Shark image follows Buddy staying still to shelter Neet and precedes Neet’s movie/glass protest. Crouching Neet and stationary Buddy beneath the shark match the current action.

Otter image follows thrown fish and You’ve been challenged, before the narrated slow slide. Fish against the far side of glass, Buddy’s amused face and Neet’s stiff attention make the physical gag legible.
findings.enrichment: Three distinct contributions: shared wonder and suspicion, protective courage beside alarm, then fish-provoked rivalry. Aquarium setting repeats appropriately; compositions and dramatic functions do not repeat the same reaction.
findings.variant: The alternative is an explicit abridgement route, not a separately repeated full transcript. Read all shared prose with the stated bridge and omissions. It removes penguins, toddler dogfish remark and the entire otter scene plus otter illustration, keeps jellyfish/shark shared art, and retains seafood dinner, toast and future-party callback. No incompatible primary-only event is assigned to the alternative.
